image_description: A large adult white pelican standing on grass next to a small, dark-feathered chick. The pelican has a long, pale orange/pinkish bill with a visible gular pouch, white plumage with black flight feathers on the wings, and short webbed feet. The background consists of green grass and a piece of driftwood.
